title: Abhisanda
text: 1. Sāvatthinidānaṃ || || 2. Cattāro me bhikkhave puññābhisandā kusalābhisandā sukhassāhārā || katame cattāro || || 3. Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti || Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti || ayam pathamo puññābhisando kusalābhisando sukhassāhāro || || 4. Puna ca param bhikkhave ariyasāvako Dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti || Svākkhāto Bhagavatā dhammo || la-pe || paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī ti || ayam dutiyo puññābhisando kusalābhisando sakhassāhāro || || 5. Puna ca param bhikkhave ariyasāvako saṅghe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti || supaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho || pa-pe || anuttaram puññakkhettaṃ lokassā ti || ayam tatiyo puññābhisando kusalābhisando sukhassā hāro || || 6. Puna ca param bhikkhave ariyasāvako Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || ayaṃ catuttho puññābhisando kusalābhisandosukhassāhāro || || 7. Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puññābhisandā kusalābhisandā {ukhassāhārā} ti || ||
